translation_notes: translated.ldpy is character-identical to original.py. Both RDF operations are URIRef(<runtime string>) where the string comes out of RdfUtils.normalize(); an IRI island (<...>, prefixed name, f<...>) needs a literal template, so neither can become one. This is a clean negative finding: term *rewriting* code -- functions that consume an existing term and mint a new one from a computed string -- gets nothing from the notation.

the region's own import lines are left exactly as upstream; the driver puts the corpus checkout of commit 05022dc4bc on sys.path (with sys.dont_write_bytecode) so that `from nanopub.trustyuri.rdf import RdfUtils` resolves to the real, pinned implementation rather than to a hand-copied shim. Identical for both representations.

driver fixtures cover every branch: uri is None; baseuri is None with hashstr None (bytes path) and with a hashstr (the except path); get_trustyuri for a URIRef inside the nanopub namespace, for a URIRef outside it, for an rdflib-generated blank node (which also mutates the shared bnodemap, compared as an argument) and for a user-named blank node.
